reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is vague and circular (the mechanism and predicted outcome merely restate the main hypothesis) and lacks a clear physical link between the clustering-to-ordering transition and specific changes in mechanical behavior.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is too generic; it does not specify how the clustering-to-ordering transition would be detected or what distinct signature in stress-strain curves or microstructural analysis would confirm or falsify it.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis does not provide a concrete, actionable mechanism or a well-defined comparison that would guide a researcher studying refractory high-entropy alloys for high-temperature service.
